sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-Ravi Kumar in Case Crime No.455 of 2016, under Sections 366, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Bewar, District Mainpuri with prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in present case.

He further submits that the applicant the applicant was named in the F.I.R. and that no allegation has been levelled against the applicant in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. on account of which, applicant was dropped from the charge sheet.
He further submits that thereafter in the trial Court, on an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. the applicant was summoned.
He further that the medical report does not corroborate with the prosecution version, thus the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

It was further argued that the applicant is languishing in jail since 27.08.2022 having no criminal history and that in case, applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in the Ravi Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34088689/
1 trial.

entities.text: Ravi Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application.
Perusal of the record shows that the victim was enticed away by the applicant and the co-accused and that the applicant was named in the F.I.R.
The victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that the applicant and the co-accused Banti took the victim in a vehicle, thereafter the co-accused Banti had committed rape.
The P.W.1 and P.W.2 has also made specific allegation against the applicant.

Thus keeping in view submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of offence, nature of allegations, and all the attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, no case for bail has been made out.
Accordingly, the bail application of applicant-Ravi Kumar, is rejected.
